title: Roti with Chickpea Curry
description: Roti with Chickpea Curry is a dish from Trinidad and Tobago featuring chickpeas, yellow onion, garlic, tomato. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used. This uses a simplified home roti and chickpea curry; Trinidad doubles and roti dough are not interchangeable.

steps.instruction: Soak the dried beans in ample clean cold water for about 360 minutes, drain and discard the soaking water; cook fully in fresh water.
Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 75 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 12 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Combine the remaining ingredients, cover partly and stew gently for about 22 minutes until the flavors meld and everything is tender.
Mix the dough ingredients, knead until smooth and elastic, then cover and rest for about 20 minutes.
Pan-fry the prepared food from the previous stages on both sides until browned and fully cooked.
Arrange the fully cooked and prepared parts of the dish on plates or in the intended serving vessel, adding the listed toppings or accompaniments just before serving.
